hint.description: empty string when there is no further hint to give; always present so clients can rely on the key existing

reason.description: Optional machine-readable sub-code for a caller that needs to branch on WHY (e.g. plugin-side messaging) without parsing `message`/`hint` prose -- present only on errors that define one (1.3.0: POST /v1/sites/{id}/verify's verification_required uses callback_unreachable/callback_timeout/callback_invalid); absent from every other error.
